data.name: Where the EU or UK GDPR applies, we process account and authentication information on the basis of our legitimate interests in providing and securing the online services you choose to use and managing user accounts, under Article 6(1)(f). These interests must be balanced against your interests, rights, and freedoms. Where processing is necessary to comply with an applicable legal obligation, we rely on Article 6(1)(c).

Når vi behandler oplysninger, du indsender med henblik på at stille spørgsmål eller få support, baserer vi os på vores legitime interesser i at besvare henvendelser og yde support.
